about_the_game:
Glitch is an intense, surreal narrative experience, drawn entirely by hand, that will make you question reality with every choice you make.

In the Middle of the Night...

It all starts in the dead of night, when you wake up and realize something is terribly wrong. A noise jolts you from sleep, the bedside clock shows a strange defect, and the very air in your room feels heavier than usual.

What begins as a simple unease quickly intensifies, turning your house into a setting of mystery and the outside world into a stage for chaos.

Your Choices Define Reality

In Glitch, every decision you make shapes the story's path and your perception of the events. You will experience storylines where the horror and chaos flow from different sources and in unique ways, pushing you to piece together each trajectory to try and unravel what is truly happening on this strange night.

  • Hand-Drawn Art: Immerse yourself in a visually unique world with a raw, engaging art style.

  • Multiple-Choice Narrative: Your actions have weight. Follow the thread of sanity... or lose it completely.

  • Over Twenty Unique Endings: Every playthrough reveals a new facet of the story. Discover the diverse possibilities and the terrifying fates that await.

The True Ending

Only the most dedicated players who uncover and experience all of the multiple endings will unlock the Special Final.

It is at this point that the curtain is lifted, the chaos is organized, and all the puzzle pieces fall into place, revealing the complete truth behind the surreal event. Do you have the courage and persistence to seek the Final Answer?

Enter the Glitch. Find the truth. Try to handle it.

content_descriptors.notes: Surreal horror, metaphoric representations of mental disorders.
